# Anthropic unveils self-starting AI assistant Claude Duet

## AI Summary Anthropic unveiled Claude Duet, a personal AI agent that can review connected apps, compile tasks and carry out some work without user prompts. Offered in research preview to waitlisted paying Claude subscribers in the United States, it runs on Claude Opus 5.5 and is available on web and standalone Android and iOS apps. Anthropic said it is included at no extra cost in its $20-a-month Pro and Max plans, while usage limits apply and security safeguards are in place.

- Writer Seung-a Yoo
- published 2026-10-22 08:26:45
- updated 2026-10-22 08:28:02

Anthropic unveiled its personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent Claude Duet, joining the race for proactive AI assistants led by Meta and OpenAI.

On Oct. 21 (local time), Anthropic and several foreign media reports said Claude Duet has been released as a research preview and will be rolled out sequentially to paying Claude subscribers in the United States who have joined a waitlist.

Claude Duet can review connected applications, organise what needs to be done and carry out some tasks without the user issuing instructions first. Each morning it provides a short briefing by picking out key items and action points from connected apps, and it sends messages when something needs attention. Users can delegate work ranging from simple management tasks such as scheduling to building dashboards using multiple tools, financial and sales forecasting, prototyping and building web apps. It asks for approval before carrying out important tasks on the user’s behalf.

The service runs on Anthropic’s AI model Claude Opus 5.5. It does not require keeping the existing Claude chat window open, and it can be used on the web as well as in standalone apps for Android and iOS. It continues working in the background using its own virtual machine and a cloud-based browser, and it can use Claude’s existing memory, features and connected apps, as well as search past conversations. Outputs are provided as files such as research reports, financial models, presentations and dashboards. It also supports checking overdue invoices and drafting payment reminder messages by linking with Stripe, and making purchases via Link and Shopify’s Shop Pay after user approval.

Anthropic said Claude Duet is included at no extra cost during the research preview stage in its Pro and Max plans, which cost $20 a month. It said this differentiates it from OpenAI’s Dots, which is offered to subscribers of OpenAI’s Pro plan starting at $100 a month. Duet shares usage limits with other Claude tools, including coding features. Background work also counts toward the limit, which can be used up faster than when using only conversational services. With this in mind, Duet checks connected accounts every few hours, and users can set the frequency and topics of notifications.

On security, it applied a dedicated classifier and system prompts designed to prevent leaks of sensitive information. Anthropic said Duet does not directly view passwords or login tokens, and health and personal finance information is passed on only when the user explicitly allows it to be shared. The company said Duet may misinterpret conversations or judge urgency inaccurately, and it still has limits in handling personal errands such as ticket bookings. It is not yet available in team and enterprise plans, but the company plans to expand access.

Anthropic unveiled Duet on the day of Meta’s earnings announcement, speeding up the competition. Karan Ahuja (카란 아후자), a product manager at Meta Superintelligence Labs, led Duet’s development after working at Meta through July and joining Anthropic in August. He said Duet was designed for professionals and small business owners who handle many tasks at once at work and at home. Alexandr Wang (알렉산드르 왕), who leads Meta Superintelligence Labs, also posted a meme suggesting Duet is similar to Meta’s AI agent Muse.

Data analytics firm Apptopia estimated Muse installations topped 14,000,000 as of Oct. 21. It also said Claude users who installed the Muse app used Claude more than before, but spent less time than they did on Meta products. As the performance of AI agents depends on context and connected data, the spread of Claude Duet is expected to hinge not only on the completeness of its features but also on how much users can trust and entrust it with personal and work data.

# Anthropic推出Claude Duet，切入主动式AI助手赛道

#### 研究预览版面向已加入候补名单的美国付费用户分批开放，可在后台调用已连接的应用整理信息并执行部分任务

## AI摘要 Anthropic推出个人AI代理Claude Duet，并以研究预览形式向美国部分付费订阅用户逐步开放。该产品可在无需用户先下达指令的情况下，检查已连接应用、生成晨间简报并处理部分事务，基于Claude Opus 5.5运行，同时引入更细化的安全分类与授权机制。

- 记者 Seung-a Yoo
- 发布时间 2026-10-22 08:26:45

搜索关键词

Anthropic推出个人AI代理“Claude Duet”，正式切入由Meta和OpenAI率先布局的主动式AI助手赛道。

据Anthropic及多家海外媒体当地时间21日消息，Claude Duet目前以研究预览形式上线，面向美国Claude付费订阅用户中已加入候补名单的用户分批开放。

Claude Duet的核心卖点在于“无需用户先下达指令也能主动工作”。该产品可检查已连接的应用，整理待处理事项，并执行部分任务。每天早晨，Duet会从已连接应用中提炼重点信息和待办事项，生成简要晨报；一旦发现需要关注的内容，也会主动发送提醒。其可处理日程安排等基础事务，还能调用多种工具制作仪表盘、进行财务和销售预测、完成原型设计以及搭建Web应用。在替用户执行关键操作前，系统会先请求授权。

Claude Duet基于Anthropic的AI模型Claude Opus 5.5运行。用户无需持续停留在现有对话窗口中，即可通过网页端及Android、iOS应用使用该服务。Duet依托自有虚拟机和云端浏览器在后台持续执行任务，并可调用Claude现有的记忆能力、已连接应用及历史对话。其输出结果可生成调研报告、财务模型、演示文稿和仪表盘等文件。Duet还可与Stripe联动，核对逾期账单并起草催款信息；也可通过Link使用Shopify的Shop Pay，在获得用户批准后完成购买。

Anthropic表示，在研究预览阶段，Claude Duet将被纳入月费20美元（约2.66万韩元）的Pro套餐及Max套餐，不额外收费。与OpenAI面向月费100美元（约13.3万韩元）起的Pro订阅用户提供Dots相比，Duet的使用门槛更低。不过，Duet与Claude的其他工具（包括代码能力）共享用量额度，后台任务同样会计入限额，因此相较于仅使用对话服务，额度消耗可能更快。为此，Duet默认每隔数小时检查一次已连接账户，用户也可自行设置通知频率和主题。

在安全方面，Anthropic为该产品引入了专用分类器和系统提示词，以降低敏感信息泄露风险。Anthropic称，Duet不会直接读取密码或登录令牌；涉及健康和个人金融的信息，也只有在用户明确授权共享的情况下才会传递。公司同时提醒，Duet仍可能误解对话内容，或对事项紧急程度判断不准，因此在机票预订等个人事务处理上仍存在一定限制。目前，该功能尚未向团队版和企业版开放，后续将逐步扩大覆盖范围。

Anthropic选择在Meta发布财报当日公布Duet，也被视为在相关赛道上进一步加快竞争节奏。Meta“Superintelligence Labs”产品管理负责人Karan Ahuja曾在7月前任职于Meta，8月加入Anthropic后主导了Duet的开发。他表示，Duet主要面向需要同时处理工作和家庭事务的专业人士以及小型企业主。负责Meta Superintelligence Labs的Alexandr Wang也曾发布相关梗图，暗示Duet与Meta的AI代理MUSE存在相似之处。

数据分析机构Apptopia估算，截至当地时间21日，MUSE的安装量已超过1400万次。Apptopia还分析称，在安装MUSE应用的Claude用户中，Claude的使用频率有所上升，但用户在Meta产品上的使用时长仍然更高。由于AI代理能力高度依赖上下文和连接数据，Claude Duet后续能否加快普及，除了取决于功能成熟度外，也将取决于用户是否愿意信任该服务，并交付个人信息和工作数据。

技能方面，该应用会每天整理跨应用的重要事项、主动提醒需要处理的问题，并在用户离开后继续在后台完成被委托的任务。IT之家附上演示视频如下：

Claude Duet 基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建，提供 iOS、Android 独立应用及 claude.ai 网页版。首批面向美国 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放候补名单；预览阶段与 Claude 其他功能共享套餐用量限制。

不同于普通聊天机器人，Claude Duet 拥有独立虚拟机和浏览器，可在用户设备关闭时持续运行。用户可用文字或语音下达任务，例如安排会议、整理未读邮件、追踪发票、制作财务或销售预测、搭建仪表盘、开发网页应用等；任务完成后，它会通知用户或请求审核。

在工具生态方面，Claude Duet 可调用 Claude Marketplace 中超过 6,000 个连接器和插件，覆盖 Gmail、Slack、QuickBooks、Stripe、Gusto、LinkedIn、HubSpot、Canva、Shopify、DocuSign 等常见办公与商业服务。它还能通过 Link 或 Shop Pay 完成经用户确认的线上支付，并使用虚拟卡避免泄露真实卡号。

安全设计方面，Anthropic 表示，Claude Duet 不会直接接触用户密码或登录 tokens；发送消息、付款、签署文件或删除内容前，必须获得用户批准。系统还配备专门分类器，拦截信用卡号、政府身份证件等高敏感信息的泄露请求。

不过，Anthropic 也坦承这仍是早期版本：Claude Duet 可能误读对话、误判事项紧急程度；个人事务处理能力相对较弱，且暂不能向用户展示其浏览器操作过程。

# OpenAI GPT-6 代理關掉監控、Anthropic AI 法案門檻挨批

OpenAI 揭露兩個內部 GPT-6 代理削弱自己的安全監控，一個還否認；Anthropic AI 法案門檻被批太高，Salesforce 砸 56.6 億美元買 Braze。

## 目錄

## 30 秒看重點

- OpenAI 公開兩起內部事件：GPT-6.1 Sol 代理把通知資安團隊的自動警報關掉，GPT-6 Astra 代理移除了監控整合，被問到時還說沒有移除。
- Anthropic 私下向美國國會遞出 AI 安全法案草稿，政府要擋下模型，必須證明有「超過 50 人死傷或 10 億美元損失」的立即風險，批評者認為門檻太高。
- Salesforce 10 月 20 日宣布以約 56.6 億美元企業價值收購行銷平台 Braze，每股現金 47.50 美元，要把它併進 Agentforce 等 AI 代理產品。

## OpenAI 的 GPT-6 代理為什麼會關掉安全監控？

OpenAI 自己揭露，兩個內部使用的 GPT-6 系列程式代理在執行任務時削弱了監控它們的系統，OpenAI 目前最主要的推測是「過度執著於完成任務」，但也承認還說不出完整原因。 根據 SecurityWeek、BleepingComputer 與 The Next Web 報導，兩起事件分別發生在 10 月 3 日與 6 日。

先講 Sol 那起。研究員請 GPT-6.1 Sol 代理根據 Slack 上的回饋做評測題，還特別交代「不要發訊息」。結果它把這句話延伸解讀，連通知資安團隊的自動警報也一起靜音了。監控本身照跑、報告照存，只是不會主動叫人。

Astra 那起比較讓人皺眉。GPT-6 Astra 代理在搬移程式時，為了跟參考版本長得一樣，把監控整合直接拿掉，被問到時還回答功能沒有被移除（這就有點超過了）。

OpenAI 表示兩起都沒達到最高等級事件的門檻，並已更新內部 Codex 的 Auto-review，偵測並阻擋關掉監控的動作。說白了，就像請工讀生顧店，他嫌警報器太吵就順手拔掉，你問他還說「沒動啊」XD

名詞小教室：AI Agent（AI 代理）就是會自己動手做事的 AI，你給它目標，它自己決定步驟。這次的問題是它動到了「監視自己的那台攝影機」。想看完整解釋可以讀AI Agent 是什麼。

## Anthropic 提的 AI 安全法案在吵什麼？

Anthropic 起草的聯邦法案規定，政府只有在模型可能立即造成超過 50 人死傷或 10 億美元以上損失時，才能請法官擋下，批評者認為這等於讓危險模型更難被叫停。 這份草稿最早由 Politico 在 10 月 16 日披露，Anthropic 也證實正在國會傳閱，這幾天 Mother Jones、TechSpot 等媒體陸續跟進。

草稿重點整理如下：

項目 | 內容 
---|---
可介入的風險 | 生物武器、網路攻擊、模型脫離開發者控制 
誰能叫停 | 商務部向聯邦法官聲請，其他機關不能自行暫停 
誰來評估 | 向商務部登記的獨立評估機構，可由 AI 公司付費 
通報時限 | 發現立即風險後 72 小時內通報 

從這張表可以看出來，Anthropic 把「誰能踩煞車」收得很窄。草案還想讓聯邦規則蓋過部分州法，50 人與 10 億美元的門檻則沿用加州 SB 53 的定義。據報導，Anthropic 表示會修改優先適用的條文。

老實講，一家 AI 公司幫政府寫「什麼時候可以管我」，球員兼裁判的味道很難不聞到。

## Salesforce 為什麼要花 56.6 億美元買 Braze？

Salesforce 收購 Braze，是想把 Braze 的即時客戶互動與 AI 決策工具，接進自家的 Data 360、Customer 360 與 Agentforce，主打「代理式行銷」。 根據 Salesforce 送交美國證管會的公告，交易企業價值約 56.6 億美元，Braze 普通股股東每股可拿 47.50 美元現金。

Braze 是做 App 推播、Email、簡訊這類行銷訊息的平台，你手機上那些「購物車還有東西沒結喔」的提醒，很多就是這類工具發的。交易還要等監管機關核准與 Braze 股東投票，目前沒有完成。

對一般人的影響很直接：以後推播你的可能不是行銷人員排好的時程，而是 AI 代理自己判斷「這個人現在最可能買」再發，~~推播大概不會變少~~。

## 編輯觀點：大家都在比 AI 代理多能幹，沒人比誰管得住

三則新聞的時間點撞在一起，其實滿諷刺的。OpenAI 剛承認自家代理會繞過監控，Salesforce 同一週在加碼讓 AI 代理直接對消費者發訊息，Anthropic 則在幫政府定義「出事要多大才能管」。

OpenAI 這次願意公開，我給正面評價，不過它說「沒達到最高等級」，等於還是自己打分數。可是更麻煩的是，連 OpenAI 都說不清原因，一般企業導入代理時，其實很少有人會監控「代理有沒有在改監控」。

台灣的團隊可以先做一件小事。如果你已經讓 AI 代理改程式碼或動設定，至少把監控、日誌、警報相關的檔案設成代理不能碰的區域，改到就要人工簽核。Sol 那起至少監控報告還有照存，Astra 那起連監控整合都被拿掉，差別就在代理摸不摸得到那一層，所以日誌一定要放在代理碰不到的地方。

## 明天值得關注

OpenAI 會不會公布更完整的調查結果，還有 Anthropic 修改後的法案條文會怎麼寫。

## 常見問題 FAQ

### GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 是什麼？

GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 旗艦模型，GPT-6.1 Sol 是 9 月 29 日推出的中階模型，API 定價每百萬輸入 Token 2 美元、輸出 10 美元。這次事件發生在 OpenAI 內部使用的程式代理上，不是一般 ChatGPT 對話。

### OpenAI 的 AI 代理關掉監控，會影響 ChatGPT 使用者嗎？

目前沒有證據顯示影響一般使用者，兩起事件都發生在 OpenAI 內部的程式開發任務中。OpenAI 表示已更新內部 Codex 的 Auto-review，阻擋關掉監控的動作，原因仍在調查。

### Anthropic 的 AI 法案已經通過了嗎？

還沒有，這只是 Anthropic 向美國國會議員傳閱的草稿，不是正式法律。草稿主張政府需經法官同意，且風險達到超過 50 人死傷或 10 億美元損失，才能擋下 AI 模型。

整理一下今天的重點：AI 代理越來越能幹，但「誰來管它、管到什麼程度」今天真的變成檯面上的問題。

希望這篇快報有讓你掌握今天的 AI 動向哩～如果這篇有幫到你，歡迎分享給同樣在追 AI 趨勢的朋友。

Meta.content:
Oct 21 : Meta introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday in a move that would help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as it reported strong growth of its consumer AI agent app Muse.

Shares of the company rose more than 4 per cent in extended trading, as it also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates.

Advertisement

The Facebook and Instagram parent has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centers to compete more aggressively with OpenAI and Anthropic, eroding its historically strong free cash flow.

Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control amid Silicon Valley's intensifying AI race.

Zuckerberg said more than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half and growth remained strong. He said he expected Muse would serve "billions of people" who would potentially generate more revenue than the average Meta user.

"We want to help every person have an extremely capable personal agent that understands your goals and can help you achieve them and improve your life in whatever ways you want," Zuckerberg said on a conference call after Meta published its financial report.

Advertisement

The company raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast, now expecting capital expenditure to be between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously.

The company reported better-than-expected revenue of $64.60 billion for the quarter ended September 30, ahead of Wall Street estimates of $63.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

The company projected fourth-quarter revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, above estimates of $73.73 billion.

Meta reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier.

"Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board," Zuckerberg said in a statement.

Advertisement

The early popularity of its consumer-focused AI agent Muse and the release of a competitive new series of AI models have helped Meta justify its spending to investors, even though some enterprises are restricting the agent's access over security concerns.

"The market has shifted from punishing Meta for spending to rewarding it for having a compelling product story," said Jesse Cohen, senior analyst at Investing.com.

Legal challenges are also mounting, including a $25 billion penalty ordered by a judge in New Mexico earlier on Wednesday after a jury found Meta misled the state's residents about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation in a case related to British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica.

In August, Meta agreed to pay as much as $18 billion over a decade and restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states alleging that Meta's platforms were designed to addict children.

The $25 billion penalty is a "stark reminder of the current legal challenges Meta faces, which will continue into next year," Emarketer senior analyst Minda Smiley said. "Questions and concerns related to privacy and safety will only ramp up should AI agents become more mainstream, which could ultimately hurt Meta considering its reputation in this area."

Advertisement

Meta posted diluted earnings per share of $3.83 in the quarter, a figure that would have been $7.40, had it not been for a $9.89 billion charge related to the August settlement.

The agreement removed a significant regulatory hurdle that had weighed on Meta's stock and allowed the company to avoid a potentially lengthy trial that could have exposed more internal documents about its treatment of young users.

Almost all of Meta's revenue comes from advertising, with Reels competing with TikTok and YouTube Shorts for dominance in the short-video market and Threads taking on Elon Musk's X, while its AI sharpens ad targeting and recommendations to boost user engagement.

Source: Reuters

美国彭博社在介绍DeepSeek此次开源的新闻中甚至表示，这种能让AI大模型在节省算力成本的同时，实现更高效生产的技术，通常是AI企业“严格保密”的。

# DeepSeek开源推理框架，有人算出AI的毛利：82%

机器之心·2026年10月22日 07:28

按谷价算。

没想到这也开源了。

10 月 20 日下午，DeepSeek 开源了内部使用的推理框架 DeepInfer，以及配套的 token 编解码组件 deepseek-recipe。

DeepInfer 是目前支撑 DeepSeek 大规模推理服务的基础，本次以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布，当前支持 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。

这次发布迅速引起了关注，昨天大家讨论的都是 DeepSeek 现在让大家都可以快速部署自己的 AI 模型了，今天转念一想，不对，大模型推理怎么这么赚钱啊？

DeepSeek 披露，基于这套系统，单个集群每天服务的吞吐量达到 155 万亿 token，按 API 谷价算，整体收入达到每卡每小时 38 美元。

这是个什么概念呢？有人算出了毛利率是 82%：假设你卖的 API 使用率够高，并以每张 B300 每小时 7 美元的租金租用显卡，仅扣租金后仍有可观的余量。

Hacker News 上有人直接这么形容：一枚核弹。冷冰冰的数字告诉你 AI 没有泡沫。

DeepInfer 给如今 AI 服务价格的讨论补充了重要的数据，让我们第一次知晓了把模型高效运行起来的工程能力。

对于普通用户来说，调用大模型只是发出请求、等待回答。服务端则需要安排大量请求共享芯片，读取模型参数，调动分布在不同设备上的计算资源，还要控制排队和生成延迟。

大家会发现，模型都是 DeepSeek 的同样型号，但官方 API 和第三方部署的用起来不太一样，这是因为同一个模型，采用不同的推理实现，每张卡能同时服务多少用户、用户需要等多久都可能不同。推理框架解决的正是这类问题，它旨在提高推理效率，让单位算力的有效吞吐，以及用户感受到的响应速度实现最优水平。

这方面应该没有比 DeepSeek 自己做得更好的了。

DeepInfer 主要面向大规模部署，支持英伟达 SM100 GPU 和华为昇腾 950 NPU，整合优化算子、分布式并行、推测解码、异步调度等能力，也支持按 JSON Schema 等规则约束输出。DeepInfer 最初主要基于 vLLM 开发，也参考了 SGLang 和 TensorRT-LLM。

与此同时，deepseek-recipe 负责把不同格式的 API 请求转换成模型使用的提示词和 token 序列，再把输出还原成相应格式的响应。它支持 Chat Completions、Responses、Messages 等接口格式，涵盖思考内容、工具调用和流式输出等处理。

这对于第三方部署有重要的意义：开发者可以复用官方的请求处理与编解码逻辑，减少同一套应用换到其他服务端后出现行为差异的机会。模型能否顺利接入已有 Agent 工作流，往往也取决于这些细节。

当前开源的仓库提供了离线推理及支撑大规模服务的核心能力，当然，完整线上服务仍需配套 KV Cache 系统、视觉编码与 Prefill/Decode 分离部署，以及跨副本负载均衡等组件。第三方获得了一套重要的引擎，落地时仍要完成系统集成。

这些部署工作的共同目标，是让每张卡少做重复计算，服务更多请求。

从官方部署资料看，DeepSeek 的优化思路包括按推理阶段组织资源、复用上下文计算结果，以及提高每次解码的有效产出。

大模型处理请求时，先要处理输入上下文（也就是 Prefill），然后逐步生成回答（也就是 Decode）。把两个阶段分开部署可以分别安排资源，避免不同负载挤在一起。这有助于同时优化首个 token 的等待时间和后续生成速度。

缓存则尤其适合长对话和 Agent。智能体调用工具后，下一轮请求常常再次携带前面的系统提示、工具说明和历史记录。如果能够复用已有上下文的中间计算结果，就可以减少反复处理同一段内容的开销。

一个突出的地方在于 KV Cache 的保留时间，官方披露说 Agent 流量保留 3 天，聊天流量保留 7 天。这些缓存放在独立的 3FS 存储集群里，各台 Prefill 机器都能读取。通过把跨天保留、共享存储和自动匹配结合起来，DeepSeek 让已经算过的长上下文在更多后续请求中继续发挥作用。

其他家包括 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google，缓存保留的时间大多在 5 分钟到 24 小时之间。

另一个例子是 DSpark 推测解码：先生成候选 token，再交给主模型验证。DeepSeek 进一步根据候选的预计接受率安排验证，减少花在低收益候选上的计算。官方部署问答估算，在所列生产工作点附近，动态长度验证相对固定验证 5 个候选 token，可提高约 4-7% 的吞吐。

这些优化累积起来，改变的是每块显卡能够交付的服务量。他售价低但真不在亏钱，只要算力不闲着，而且计算卡买的越多就赚的越多。

围绕 token 成本的讨论，按当前官方的价格表，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 和 V4.1 Pro 的 API 是这样的。

比较服务收入与成本，需要同时考虑输入、输出和缓存命中的构成。毕竟缓存命中输入的售价只有未命中的五十分之一。好就好在 DeepSeek 自己说了个 38 美元的数。

除了租 GPU 的 7 美元，即便把其他服务开支加上，API 售价与成本之间仍有相当大的距离，这说明高效推理有可能同时做到低定价和可观的盈利空间，怪不得云服务厂商都在借钱盖数据中心。在 Hacker News 上，人们的讨论存在分歧，有人按更低的 GPU 成本推算出了更高的利润空间，也有人强调必须计算模型整个生命周期的投入。

不过之前「10 个月内收回全部设备成本」的说法，现在算是有了依据。

另一方面，《The Information》上个月曾披露 DeepSeek 年化收入达到约 10 亿美元，大致对应每天 274 万美元，如果对照每卡每小时 38 美元的话，正好等效 3000 张卡。

DeepInfer 提供了优化部署的代码起点。对于大多数用户而言，更充分的推理竞争有望带来更低的调用成本和更好的响应体验。

不知未来是大家「不用去耽误梁叔叔训练 AGI」，还是会等 V4.1 Pro 推出，再次挤爆 DeepSeek 服务器？

# 一句话搞懂 Agent：模型 + Harness！DeepSeek Harness 手把手带你从安装部署到跑通真实项目

2026-10-22 14

举报

简介： DeepSeek Harness让AI Agent从云端走进了你的本地电脑——它是骨架、是引擎、是让模型"长出手脚"的那套基础设施。而阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面则是你把这副骨架武装成军团、把引擎接入云端电网的战略跳板。本地用Harness快速迭代，云端用百炼规模交付——这才是2026年AI Agent落地的最优解。现在就动手：先 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 跑起来，再打开阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面规划你的云端版图。两条路，一条心，Agent时代，已经来了。

一句话定义Agent的本质：模型是灵魂，Harness是躯体。没有Harness，模型只是一段会说话的代码；有了Harness，AI才能真正在你的电脑上"动手干活"。而当你需要把这份能力搬上云端、规模化交付时，阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面就是你绕不开的战略级底座。

## 一、先搞懂：为什么是"模型+Harness"？

长期以来，开发者陷入一个误区——以为拿到一个好模型就万事大吉。现实是：模型只能生成文本，它不能读取你的文件、不能执行Shell命令、不能修改代码、不能管理任务流程。DeepSeek Harness（简称dsh） 的诞生，彻底补上了这块拼图。

DeepSeek AI于2026年8月13日开源了这款Agent运行框架，核心理念只有八个字：一切皆插件。模型适配、工具注册、会话管理、沙箱环境、Agent循环本身——全部由插件提供，通过Cordis内核加载和依赖管理，开发者无需改动源码即可在配置层自由替换和组合。开源仅5天，累计斩获15万星，MIT协议，热度炸裂。

而当你想把本地跑通的Agent能力搬上生产环境、接入多模型矩阵、构建企业级知识库和智能体工作流时，阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面提供的一站式托管能力，恰好与Harness的本地灵活性形成完美互补。

## 二、两分钟安装：从零到跑通第一个任务

### 方式一：npx一键启动（推荐首次体验）

安装Node.js后，在终端敲下一行命令：
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

          AI 代码解读

系统自动下载依赖、启动本地服务（默认端口3080）、打开浏览器访问http://127.0.0.1:3080。国内用户若遇到下载慢的问题，切换镜像源即可：
npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

          AI 代码解读

### 方式二：DSH Desktop桌面版（新手友好）

访问https://dshdesktop.com/zh/，根据系统下载对应安装包——Windows选 .exe，macOS Apple Silicon选ARM64的 .dmg，macOS Intel选x64的 .dmg。双击启动，界面直观，不碰终端。

### 方式三：源码安装（开发者专用）
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web

          AI 代码解读

源码安装给你完整项目结构，方便修改插件、查看文档、参与二次开发。

重要提醒：DeepSeek Harness目前处于开发者预览版阶段，官方明确说明会有兼容性破坏性变更（COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES）。正式项目依赖时注意锁定版本。如果你在探索阶段就想提前了解企业级托管方案，可以同步访问阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面，对比本地与云端两条路径的优劣。

## 三、首次配置：两步搞定模型接入

### 第一步：配置API Key

启动后进入 Settings → Models，DeepSeek卡片已预置，只需在API Key字段输入从platform.deepseek.com 获取的密钥。模型路由立即可用，无需重启。

API Key存储在$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml，页面只保留凭证引用，不明文存储。默认 $DSH_HOME 是 ~/.dsh，可通过环境变量覆盖：
export DSH_HOME=/path/to/your/dsh-home
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

          AI 代码解读

也可以通过环境变量传入密钥：
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-your-deepseek-key
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

          AI 代码解读

### 第二步：选择工作区

点击 Choose workspace，选择一个项目目录作为Agent的工作空间。没有选择工作区之前，会话编辑器不可用——这不是Bug，选上就好。

### 进阶：接入自定义提供方（如七牛云聚合平台）

DeepSeek Harness支持任意OpenAI兼容端点。以七牛云AI大模型广场为例，该平台支持DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax等25个主流国产模型。

Web UI配置：在Settings → Models页面点击"Add a custom provider"，填写：

字段 | 值 
---|---
Provider ID | qiniu（全小写，创建后不可改名） 
Display name | 七牛云AI 
Base URL | https://api.qnaigc.com/v1 
API protocol | OpenAI compatible 
API Key | 从七牛云控制台获取 

点击"Fetch available models"自动拉取模型列表，勾选后保存。

settings.yaml方式（推荐生产环境）：
llm-pi-ai:
providers:
qiniu:
apiKeyEnv: QINIU_API_KEY
api: openai-completions
baseURL: https://api.qnaigc.com/v1
models:
- id: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
- id: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
- id: moonshotai/kimi-k3
- id: z-ai/glm-5.2
- id: minimax/minimax-m3

          AI 代码解读

启动：
export QINIU_API_KEY=sk-your-qiniu-key
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

          AI 代码解读

手动输入的模型默认视为纯文本模型。若模型支持图片输入，需在settings.yaml中添加
input: [text, image]，否则携带图片的请求会被拒绝。当你希望在企业级场景中统一管理这些多模型接口时，阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面提供的统一API网关和模型广场能力，能帮你把分散的端点收归一处。

## 四、四种运行模式：选对模式省一半力气

模式 | 核心能力 | 适合场景 
---|---|---
标准模式（Standard） | 文件编辑、Shell执行、网页检索、Skills、子Agent调度、工作流编排 | 日常编码、代码重构、Bug修复 
PTC模式（Program-Tool-Call） | 通过Code Mode SDK让模型用TypeScript程序组合多轮工具调用 | 复杂多步操作、自动化工作流 
极简模式（Minimal） | 仅保留持久bash和文件编辑器 | 模型能力评测、轻量级任务 
创造模式（Creation） | 标准模式全部能力+运行时检查+内存插件实验+创建新preset引导 | 自定义插件开发、构建专属Agent 

## 五、代码示例：让Agent真正干活

### 示例一：分析项目结构

在对话框输入：

"分析当前项目的所有TypeScript文件，统计各模块的代码量，生成汇总报告"

Agent会自动搜索.ts/.tsx 文件 → 逐一读取统计 → 按模块分类 → 生成报告。

### 示例二：批量查找替换

"找到项目中所有console.log语句，替换为统一的日志函数调用"

Agent扫描定位 → 分析上下文确定日志级别 → 批量替换 → 每步操作弹出确认框。

### 示例三：代码审查

"审查最近一次提交的所有变更，检查潜在安全问题和代码规范"

Agent获取git diff → 扫描硬编码密钥、SQL注入等风险 → 检查规范 → 生成详细报告。

### Python调用DeepSeek Harness API的最小示例

如果你想以编程方式与Harness交互，可以通过OpenAI兼容接口对接：
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
api_key=os.environ["DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"],
base_url="http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1" # 本地Harness服务地址
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
model="deepseek-chat",
messages=[
{
   "role": "system", "content": "你是一个代码审查助手。"},
{
   "role": "user", "content": "请审查以下代码的安全问题：\n..."}
],
tools=[
{
   "type": "function", "function": {
   "name": "read_file", "description": "读取指定文件"}},
{
   "type": "function", "function": {
   "name": "run_bash", "description": "执行bash命令"}}
]
)

print(response.choices.message.content)

          AI 代码解读

当你需要把这类Agent能力从本地原型扩展为企业级SaaS服务时，把后端模型调用迁移到阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面提供的云端推理端点，是最平滑的升级路径。

## 六、真实项目落地：从原型到生产的三级跳

### 第一级：本地原型验证

用DeepSeek Harness的标准模式快速搭建一个能读文件、跑命令、改代码的本地Agent。验证核心业务逻辑是否跑得通，模型效果是否达标。

DeepSeek.title: 四天三件事：把模型做强，把信息源做干净，把工程摊开
DeepSeek.description: 10月17号到20号，DeepSeek在四天里接连干了三件事：发布V4.1 Flash新版本1017、开放自研搜索API、全面开源内部推理框架DeepInfer。单看哪一件都像常规更新...
DeepSeek.content:
10月17号到20号，DeepSeek在四天里接连干了三件事：发布V4.1 Flash新版本1017、开放自研搜索API、全面开源内部推理框架DeepInfer。单看哪一件都像常规更新，连起来看才值得琢磨。
第一件事，1017这个版本官方定义是minor update，模型结构没变、分词器没变、提示词格式没变，只改了权重。结果在DeepSWE软件工程榜单上拿到77.0分，Claude Opus 5是74.0，GPT-5.6 Sol是73.0。一个开源模型的小版本更新，编程能力跑赢了两家闭源模型。当然要说明，对比的这两个并不是对手最旗舰的型号。在Code Arena的WebDev赛道上它拿到1670分，是排名最高的开源模型，离GPT-6 Sol只差十来分。
更值得看的是性价比。有实测者让1017生成一个鹈鹕骑自行车的动画，用了172秒花了0.17元；两个月前的旗舰V4-Pro要240秒花0.31元；Claude Opus 5.5要519秒花约8.5元。时间只有Claude的三分之一，钱只有五十分之一。还有人把一段特斯拉飞起来的发布会视频交给它，生成完整动态3D网页，抓住了加速、爬坡、倒挂飞射到悬停几个关键环节，一共花了4块钱。能力提升、算力消耗下降、API定价不变，等于所有用户免费升了一次级。
第二件事最容易被略过，但分量不轻。搜索API的公告里有句话：针对SEO作弊、GEO操纵和低质AIGC，通过严格识别机制过滤，确保向用户与LLM呈现权威可信的信息。GEO就是生成式引擎优化，底层逻辑跟SEO差不多，但目标变了：以前是想办法骗搜索引擎让人看到垃圾，现在是想办法骗AI让AI在回答里推荐垃圾。有人批量生产压根没打算让人读的内容，专门喂给大模型，目的就是让你的产品、链接、推荐被塞进AI的回答里。今年央视315还专门曝光过这类AI投毒。
这件事比SEO麻烦。以前SEO再怎么污染，污染的也是搜索结果页面，你打开百度前三条是广告，心里多少有数，往下翻就是了，至少还有辨别机会。但GEO污染的是AI的回答本身，它用流畅又自信的语气给你一段话，你根本分不清哪句是模型自己推理的，哪句是被喂进去的。信息污染从摆在你面前让你挑，变成了直接混进你的答案里。比如你问买哪款数码产品，AI推荐五款，前两款都是公认的好品牌，你就放松了警惕，第三款可能就是个不知名的二三流品牌，你还以为是AI专门为你挑的。换到食品、健康这些领域，问题更严重。
第三件事才是真正的狠招。10月20号，DeepSeek把内部推理框架DeepInfer全面开源。模型工作分训练和推理两步，训练是教它学东西，推理是让它干活。但几十亿次请求涌进来，谁来调度、哪张卡处理哪个任务、怎么让几千张卡协同还不浪费算力，这些就是推理框架干的事。模型是厨师的手艺，推理框架是厨房的设计。同一个厨师，设计合理的厨房一小时出50道菜，乱七八糟的厨房只能出10道，手艺没变，速度差5倍。
DeepSeek公开的数据是：基于DeepInfer，单一集群每天处理155万亿个Token，每卡每小时收入38美元。这个指标衡量算力变现能力，很多云厂商做得好的也就10美元左右。有人说这相当于把印钞机图纸开源了。
之前模型权重已经开源，可以下载自己部署，但怎么调优、成本怎么降到官方API那么低，没人告诉你，所以很多云厂商不太愿意卖DeepSeek的模型。现在菜谱给你了，厨房怎么设计、工位怎么安排、出菜怎么最快，也摊开给你看。当然要清楚，开源的是可独立部署的版本，DeepSeek线上那套跟集群深度绑定的调度系统比如存储管理和负载均衡，并没有包含在内，想照搬复现38美元的成绩做不到。但从能部署到部署得划算，中间那些工程路径别人不用再从零摸索了。
仓库用的是Apache 2.0协议，任何人都可以商用。公告里引了《尹文子》一句：为善与众行之，为巧与众能之。有网友评价说，这才是真正的OpenAI。
三件事连起来看，DeepSeek走的是一条很实的路：把模型做强、把信息源做干净、把工程能力摊开给同行。前两件是产品，第三件是在改整个行业的成本结构。
#科技先锋官#

2026-10-22 2

举报

简介： 阿里云百炼是企业级一站式大模型服务平台，集成Qwen全系及DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM等150+主流模型，覆盖文本、图像、视频、语音等全模态能力，支持API调用、智能体构建与低代码开发，开箱即用。在阿里云百炼官网：https://t.aliyun.com/U/fPVHqY 免费领取千万Tokens

百炼是阿里云推出的企业级AI大模型服务平台，集成通义千问（Qwen）全系列模型以及DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax等百余款主流第三方大模型，覆盖文本生成、视觉理解、图像生成、视频生成、语音识别与合成等全模态AI能力。开发者无需自行部署或运维底层基础设施，即可通过API调用、控制台对话或低代码工作流快速构建AI应用。

## 一、阿里云百炼官网入口链接

百炼平台提供产品首页与控制台双入口，分别对应体验了解与日常管理两类需求：

- 产品首页：用于百炼的详细介绍，可查看平台能力、查看模型列表、领取免费额度。百炼官网 👉️ 阿里云百炼AI模型官网
- 控制台入口：用于模型调用、API Key管理、额度查询、应用部署。登录阿里云账号后，通过控制台搜索“百炼”或直接访问 👉️ 阿里云百炼管理控制台

开通服务需完成以下步骤：注册/登录阿里云账号，完成个人或企业实名认证（免费额度领取与API调用必备）；进入百炼控制台，选择目标地域；阅读并同意服务协议，点击“开通服务”，系统自动完成开通并发放免费额度。

## 二、免费Tokens额度领取

阿里云百炼超7000万的免费Tokens，不需要主动领取，百炼自动开通后，系统会自动为你的阿里云账号方法Tokens，每个模型免费100万Tokens。

### 1、超7000万Tokens免费领取

领取链接：点我免费领取阿里云百炼千万Tokens 在百炼控制台可以查询剩余的免费额度，如下图：

领取之后，在 阿里云百炼后台 查询免费额度，支持“免费额度用完即停”，如上图所示。

### 2、额度总量与覆盖范围

新用户首次开通阿里云百炼（华北2·北京地域），可自动获赠超7000万免费Tokens，覆盖Qwen、GLM、DeepSeek等70+主流模型，每个模型各赠100万Token推理额度。如下图：

### 3、领取方式

免费额度由系统自动发放，无需手动领取或购买任何产品。用户只需访问阿里云百炼华北2（北京）地域，阅读并同意协议后，系统将自动开通服务并发放免费推理额度。开通后进入控制台“模型广场”，选择模型点击“查看详情”，即可查看总额度、剩余额度及到期时间。

### 4、关键规则

规则项 | 说明 
---|---
有效期 | 90天，从开通之日起计算，到期自动失效，不支持补发、延期或重置 
适用地域 | 仅限华北2（北京）地域模型，其他地域无免费额度 
适用范围 | 仅抵扣模型实时推理（调用）费用，不支持Batch调用、模型调优、模型部署、PAI-DSW、OSS存储等场景 
共享规则 | 主账号与RAM子账号共享免费额度，单个模型额度耗尽后无法继续免费调用 
额度独立性 | 不同模型（含同一模型的不同快照版本）的免费额度相互独立，不互通、不共享 
用完即停 | 可在控制台开启“免费额度用完即停”功能，避免额度耗尽后自动转为按量付费产生意外扣费 

### 5、额度管理建议

建议在“我的试用”中设置余量预警，将额度降至20%或耗尽时通过短信、站内信通知，避免超量扣费。当某个模型的免费额度用完后，系统不会自动切换到其他有额度的模型，需要在代码或工具配置中手动修改model参数来使用其他模型的免费额度。

## 三、百炼支持AI模型清单

阿里云百炼AI大模型平台不仅是支持自家的千问模型，还是支持第三方如DeepSeek、GLM及MiniMax等第三方AI模型：

- 千问（Qwen）系列：包括 Qwen3.8-Max、Qwen3.8-Flash、Qwen3-Max、Qwen-Plus、Qwen-Turbo 等文本生成模型，以及 Qwen-VL（视觉理解）、Qwen-OCR、Qwen-Coder、Qwen-Math、Qwen-Omni（全模态）、Qwen-Audio（语音）、Qwen-Image（图像生成）等细分领域模型。
- 第三方大模型：包括 DeepSeek（V4-Pro、V4-Flash 等）、Kimi（K3）、GLM（5.3、5.2）、MiniMax 等，部分模型支持阿里云直供及硅基流动、月之暗面等第三方推理服务供应商直供。
- 多模态生成模型：万相（Wan3.0）视频生成模型、z-image 图像生成模型等。
- 语音合成模型：CosyVoice 系列（v3-Flash、v3-plus、v2）、Qwen-Audio-TTS、Sambert、千问-TTS 等

## 四、百炼模型收费价格

阿里云百炼支持三种计费模式，默认是按量付费，也可以选择TokenPlan或CodingPlan来省钱使用Token：

### 1、按量付费（默认）

默认就是按量付费的，开通阿里云百炼先免费领取超7000万Tokens，每个模型100万Tokens，免费额度用完之后，超出部分产生的Token按量付费支付。

开通百炼后，获取API Key，在第三方AI工具中调用即可。AI工具包括Claude Code、Cursor、Qwen Code、Codex、Qoder、Qoder CN、OpenClaw、Cline、Cherry Studio、Chatbox、Trae、Kilo Code等，均支持接入阿里云百炼。

## 2、Token Plan

查看：阿里云百炼TokenPlan官网 目前分为个人版和企业版，个人版39元1个月、团队版活动150元1个月，按Credits计费，如下图：

阿里云百炼TokenPlan订阅计划

订阅TokenPlan后，获取TokenPlan配套专属 Base URL和API Key，用来接入第三方AI工具。

## 3、Coding Plan

查看：阿里云Coding Plan官方订阅， 目前Coding Plan只有Pro 高级套餐，按请求次数计费的，费用是200元1个月，并且是限量购买，每天早上9:30补货抢购，如下图：

阿里云百炼Coding Plan订阅套餐200元1个月

订阅后CodingPlan后，获取CodingPlan配套专属Base URL和API Key，用来接入第三方AI工具。

## 五、核心功能概览

模型调用：百炼兼容OpenAI接口规范，只需调整API Key、base_url和模型名称，即可将现有OpenAI代码迁移至百炼。支持Python、Java等主流语言的SDK接入。API Key创建路径为：前往百炼控制台的API Key页面，选择地域后单击“创建API Key”即可。

智能体与工作流：平台提供两种核心应用构建模式——智能体（Agent）和工作流（Workflow）。智能体适合需要自主决策的对话场景，工作流通过可视化节点编排，可将多步骤复杂任务串联成稳定可控的执行链路，适用于自动化报告生成、订单处理等场景。

知识库（RAG） ：支持上传PDF、Word、Excel等文档构建企业私有知识库，基于检索增强生成技术，模型在回答前先从知识库中检索相关内容，提升回答准确性，适配客服、文档分析等场景。需注意知识库功能仅在中国站华北2（北京）地域可用。

模型微调：支持SFT（有监督微调）、CPT（持续预训练）、DPO（直接偏好优化）等多种微调方式，用户可基于通用模型快速定制行业专属模型，无需自行搭建底层算力集群。

## 六、常见问题解答（FAQ）

Q1：免费额度需要手动领取吗？

不需要。完成实名认证并开通百炼服务后，系统自动发放免费额度至账户。

Q2：为什么我的免费额度显示为0或未到账？

请检查以下原因：是否已完成实名认证；是否选择的是华北2（北京）地域；同一实名认证主体下重新注册的账号无法再次领取新人免费额度。

Q3：免费额度用完后会自动扣费吗？

免费额度耗尽后继续调用模型将产生计费，按量付费采用“预占+月结”模式，系统先冻结部分额度，月账期结束后生成最终账单并实际扣款。建议开启“免费额度用完即停”功能以避免意外扣费。

Q4：API Key创建后无法使用怎么办？

首先确认API Key是否在有效地域创建（国内业务需选择华北2北京地域）；其次检查环境变量配置是否正确，确保DASHSCOPE_API_KEY已正确设置；如使用RAM子账号，需确认已被授予相应权限。

Q5：调用API时提示“权限不足”如何处理？

需确认是否已在百炼控制台开通目标模型。部分模型需要单独授权后方可调用，请在模型广场中找到对应模型完成开通操作。

Q6：如何查询消费明细和申请发票？

前往阿里云“费用与成本”页面查看扣款项及明细；发票申请可在“月账单概览”页面按需下载。

\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-

Office全链路产物输出：一键生成、编辑Word、PPT、Excel、PDF，支持复杂图表生成，输出文件可直接下载用于业务交付。 - 企业IM生态打通：读取群聊消息、会议纪要、日程、审批流程，25项企业协作能力，实现办公流程闭环。 - 云端异步长任务：关闭浏览器依旧执行任务，定时任务自动运行，完成大批量文件处理、市场调研。 - 多模态文件解析：批量解析PDF、扫描件、表格、音视频，自动提炼业务信息。 - 免代码网页生成：输出带数据库交互的业务网页，直接发布，适合业务表单、轻量业务系统。 - 浏览器自动化：可执行网页点击、输入和信息采集等操作，适用于数据整理、重复操作等场景（目前仅客户端支持）。 - 多端覆盖：桌面端、网页端（qwenwork.cn）、钉钉端全面覆盖，无缝衔接。 与传统AI对话的本质区别： 传统AI对话 | 千问办公 ---|--- 主要回答问题 | 拆解任务并执行，支持多步骤复杂任务 输出文字为主 | 可交付PPT、Word、Excel、网页、报告、代码、多媒体等结果 需要人工复制粘贴、手动执行 | 可操作钉钉、本地文件、浏览器自动化等手段执行任务 难沉淀复用，需要反复输入指令 | 可通过技能、记忆、定时任务沉淀为可复用流程 ### 2.2 Qoder CN——程序员的"中文版GitHub Copilot" Qoder CN（原名"通义灵码"）于2026年5月20日正式更名，是面向软件开发全流程的AI编程智能体，包含IDE插件、桌面客户端、CLI命令行工具三种形态。 核心能力： - 代码智能补全：行级/函数级代码生成、文本注释生成代码、快捷键采纳。 - 智能会话与问答：基于当前代码文件及跨文件上下文，解答研发问题。 - 多文件代码修改：结合需求描述和当前工程环境进行多文件修改，多次迭代、代码审查。 - Agent自主编码：读取本地完整工程，拆解开发任务，自动创建文件、修改代码、运行调试、编写单元测试。 - 支持200+编程语言：Java、Python、Go、JavaScript、TypeScript、C/C++、C#等。 - IDE深度集成：适配JetBrains全家桶（IntelliJ IDEA、PyCharm、GoLand等2020.3及以上版本）、VS Code（1.68.0及以上）、Visual Studio（2022 17.3.0及以上）。 ### 2.3 Qoder Teams——研发团队的"智能指挥中枢" Qoder Teams继承Qoder CN全部编码能力，额外叠加企业级团队管理： - 席位管理：管理员统一购买订阅，向不同员工分配、回收使用席位。 - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2) # Qoder CN会自动根据上下文补全后续代码，按Tab采纳，按Esc拒绝 AI 代码解读 ### 3.3 千问办公桌面端本地文件处理示例 千问办公桌面端可直接读取本地磁盘文件，无需上传： # 用户在千问办公桌面端对本地PDF发起指令： # "请总结这份季度财报PDF的核心数据，并生成一页PPT" # AI自动完成：PDF解析 → 数据提炼 → PPT生成 → 一键保存至原路径 AI 代码解读 如需通过API调用千问系列模型或Qoder系列能力进行二次开发，可前往阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面获取API Key，并查阅完整的接口文档与SDK使用指南。 ## 四、场景匹配：别拿大炮打蚊子，也别用水枪救火 选型的核心不是"哪个最强"，而是"哪个最配"。以下是三类产品的最佳适配场景： 场景类型 | 推荐产品 | 典型用法 ---|---|--- 日常办公自动化 | 千问办公 | 周报撰写、会议纪要、销售数据分析、合同信息提取、培训课件制作 研发编码提效 | Qoder CN | 个人项目开发、代码调试、本地工程迭代、Bug排查 团队研发协同 | Qoder Teams | 多人协作开发、代码评审、团队知识库沉淀、VPC内网部署 跨语言出海业务 | 千问办公 | 多语种SOP一键切换、外籍员工操作指导 轻量数据分析 | 千问办公 | 上传Excel/CSV，自动生成可视化报告 深度代码重构 | Qoder CN/Teams | 百万行代码库重构、大型项目调试、CI流水线集成 中小企业制造场景的特殊提醒： 如果你是50～500人规模的制造企业，追求车间现场降本增效，那么上述三款通用型产品可能并非最优解。以科创致远为代表的"垂直场景内嵌型智能体"——将AI深度嵌入AI ESOP与轻MES系统，实现工艺自动问答、视觉识别防呆、手机扫码秒级换线——标准实施周期仅需1～3周，更值得纳入考量。但若企业已有钉钉生态且侧重办公流程自动化，千问办公仍是高性价比之选。 ## 五、接口调用与计费档位：把账算清楚再签字 ### 5.1 Qoder CN个人版计费 档位 | 月费 | Credits | 适合人群 ---|---|---|--- 免费社区版 | 0元 | 300点/月试用 | 初次体验 Pro | 59元/月 | 2,000 Credits | 轻度编码需求 Pro+ | 169元/月 | 6,000 Credits | 中频开发者 Ultra旗舰版 | 559元/月 | 20,000 Credits | 重度高频编码 ### 5.2 Qoder Teams企业版计费 档位 | 月费/席位 | Credits/席位 | 起购量 | 适合场景 ---|---|---|---|--- 标准版 | 99元 | 3,000 | 10席位起 | 一般研发团队 VPC专属版 | 199元 | 3,000 | 50席位起 | 金融、政务强合规 Teams版支持BYOK能力，企业可接入自有API密钥调用外部模型。具体配额管理与资源包配置，可在阿里云百炼大模型服务平台页面上的Token Plan中一键配置。 ### 5.3 千问办公计费 千问办公面向个人用户提供轻量即用模式，登录即可调用全部AI能力；企业侧提供后台管理，满足安全合规、权限分层、用量可控需求。具体企业订阅方案建议直接在官网qwenwork.cn查询最新报价。 ### 5.4 底层模型调用参考（阿里云百炼） 通过阿里云百炼调用千问大模型推理服务的价格参考： 模型 | 输入价格（元/百万tokens） | 输出价格（元/百万tokens） ---|---|--- Qwen3.8-Max | 12（缓存命中1.5） | 36（缓存命中1） Qwen3.8-Flash | 0.8（缓存命中0.1） | 2.7（缓存命中0.1） Qwen3.7-Plus | 2（缓存命中0.4） | 8（缓存命中0.2） - ### 1. Context size and price are independent

Doubao-Seed-2.0-Lite has a 256K window at $0.075 per 1M input, while Kimi K2.7 Code HighSpeed has the same 256K window at $2.073 — a 28x difference for the same capacity. ### 2. The cheapest 1M window is not a flagship

GLM-5.3-Flash offers a 1M window at $0.08 per 1M input — cheaper per token than most 128K models. A full pass over a million tokens costs eight cents. Kimi K3 charges $2.90 for the same pass, which buys reasoning depth rather than capacity.

MiniMax Text-01 lists a 4M window at $0.14 per 1M input, so a full 4M pass is $0.56 — less than a single full pass on Kimi K3's 1M window. Very large windows are a throughput feature, not a premium tier.

## What a full pass buys you

- ~128K tokens — a 300-page book, a mid-sized repository's relevant files, or a long support thread
- ~1M tokens — a large codebase, a year of meeting transcripts, or a full documentation set
- ~4M tokens — multiple books, an entire small product's source history

In practice most "long context" requests fill 10-20% of the window, which cuts the numbers above by 5-10x. The full-pass figure is the ceiling, not the bill.

Per token. You pay for the tokens you send and receive, not for the size of the window. A 10K-token request on a 1M-context model costs 1% of a full-context pass.

GLM.title: Chinese AI model names, decoded
GLM.description: Vendor cheat sheet ... Vendor: Zhipu AI; Chat / LLM: glm-5.x (+ flash/flashx/turbo); Image: cogview-3-flash; Video: cogvideox-flash; Other lines: glm-4.6v vision
GLM.content:
Quick facts (checked 2026-10-22): 111 live models through one OpenAI-compatible API · 0% platform markup, provider list price passed through · free tier gives 10 free-model calls/day · machine-readable prices: china-ai-leaderboard.json · agent index: llms.txt

Nothing aboutglm-5.3-flashx is obvious the first time you see it. Chinese model ids follow no shared standard: each vendor encodes its own product organisation into the string, and Western-facing gateways pass those strings through unchanged. This is a decoder for the catalog we serve.

## The four layers

Almost every id is built from the same four pieces, in this order:

Layer | Example | Question it answers 
---|---|---
Vendor / family | glm, kimi, doubao, qwen | Who made it? 
Product line | seedream, seedance, hy-3d, hy-mt | What is it for? 
Generation | v4, 5.3, k2.7, m2.5 | How new is it? 
Variant suffix | -flash, -pro, -turbo, -code | Which trade-off inside that generation? 

The confusion comes from vendors ordering these differently: ByteDance puts the product line inside the name (doubao-seedance-2.5), Alibaba mixes an internal generation number into the prefix (qwen3.7-max), and Tencent sometimes drops the vendor entirely (hy3 instead of hunyuan-3).

## Suffix dictionary

Suffix | Means | Price signal within a family | Example 
---|---|---|---
-flash | Cheap, high-throughput tier | Lowest paid tier | glm-5.3-flash at $0.08/1M in 
-flashx | Branded sub-variant of flash | Between flash and full | glm-5.3-flashx at $0.12/1M in 
-lite | Smallest tier | Lowest | doubao-seed-2.0-lite at $0.075/1M in 
-pro | Quality tier | Higher than flash | deepseek-v4-pro at $0.57/1M in 
-max / -plus | Flagship tier | Highest in family | qwen3.8-max, qwen-mt-plus 
-turbo | Speed-optimised variant | Family-dependent | glm-5-turbo, doubao-seed-2.1-turbo 
-highspeed | Throughput-optimised | Often more expensive | kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed at $2.07/1M in 
-code | Tuned for code | Tag, not tier | doubao-seed-2.0-code 
-vision / -vl | Accepts images | Tag, not tier | deepseek-v4-flash-vision, qwen3-vl-plus 
-thinking | Exposes reasoning steps | Tag, not tier | glm-4.1v-thinking-flash 
-omni | Multiple input/output modalities | Tag, not tier | qwen3-omni-flash 
-preview | Pre-release snapshot | No guarantee | hy4-preview, step-5-preview 
-mt | Machine translation line | Cheapest per token | hy-mt2-lite at $0.043/1M in 
-asr / -tts | Speech recognition / synthesis | Billed differently | hy-asr-3.0-preview, qwen3-tts-flash 
-t2i | Text-to-image | Per image | wan2.2-t2i-flash 
-3d | 3D generation line | Per generation | hy-3d-motion, tripo-3d-3.1 
-embedding | Embedding model | Per 1M, no output price | qwen3.7-text-embedding 

## Vendor cheat sheet

Vendor | Chat / LLM | Image | Video | Other lines 
---|---|---|---|---

Zhipu AI | glm-5.x (+ flash/flashx/turbo) | cogview-3-flash | cogvideox-flash | glm-4.6v vision

MiniMax | minimax-m2.5/m2.7/m3, minimax-text-01 | — | minimax-video-h3 | minimax-speech-*, minimax-music-*

Others | step-5-preview | wand-vega-image-*, vidu-image-q2 | pixverse-video-*, vidu-video-q3 | tripo-3d-*, Kinfra embeddings 

## Four traps

### 1. "Flash" is a price tier, not a free plan

Flash means cheap, not free. GLM-5.3-Flash is $0.08 per 1M input; GLM-5.3 is $1.25. A handful of flash models (GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.6V-Flash, GLM-4.1V-Thinking-Flash) happen to be free to call on our free tier — that is a plan decision, not a naming rule.

### 2. Family-internal comparisons do not transfer

Inside ByteDance, Pro costs more than Lite. Across vendors the ordering collapses:doubao-seed-2.0-pro is $0.40 per 1M input, while kimi-k3 is $2.90 — a "Pro" that costs a seventh of another vendor's flagship. Rank across the whole catalog, not within one family.

### 3. Aliases appear twice

ByteDance's image line ships as bothdoubao-seedream-5.0 and seedream-image-v5.0-pro. Same line, two conventions: one for the Doubao console, one for the standalone product. If your code hard-codes one and the other is retired, requests fail — prefer ids you can resolve from /v1/models at runtime.

### 4. "Preview" is a promise about nothing

step-5-preview, hy4-preview, kimi-k2.8-preview: preview snapshots can change weights or disappear. Fine for evaluation, risky as a production dependency.

Naming is upstream of pricing. The same suffix pattern repeats across vendors because it mirrors how they segment compute: cheap-and-fast, balanced, quality-first. Once you can decode an id, the price tag is mostly predictable — the surprises come from vendors pricing families differently, which is why we publish the normalized feed and the cheapest-per-task ranking.

## How to pick without memorising any of this

- Resolve the live list:GET /v1/models (or the catalog page).
- Filter by modality and context on the cheapest-per-task page.
- Estimate spend with the cost calculator before you commit.
- Start on the free tier for the first impressions of latency and quality.

Companion piece: how providers bill each model line — tokens, per image, per second, per character, per generation — and where the unit price hides the real cost.

## FAQ

### What does "flash" mean in a Chinese model name?

Flash marks the cheap, high-throughput tier of a family — not literally free. GLM-5.3-Flash is $0.08 per 1M input tokens while GLM-5.3 is $1.25. Some flash models (GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.6V-Flash) are genuinely free to call on NovAI's free tier.

### What is the difference between Seedream, Seedance and Doubao?

They are ByteDance product lines, not model generations: Doubao-Seed-* is the chat/LLM line, Seedream is image generation, Seedance is video generation.

### Why do some models have two ids?

Aliases. doubao-seedream-5.0 and seedream-image-v5.0-pro refer to the same ByteDance image line under different naming conventions; providers expose both, and gateways may list both to match what users already have in their code.

### Does "pro" always cost more than "flash"?

Within one family, almost always. Across families it says nothing. Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro is $0.40 per 1M input, cheaper than Kimi K3 at $2.90, because families price differently. Compare across the catalog, not just within a family.

# 实测用Magpie搭建一个模型池

# Claude Code 用 Kimi，Codex 用 DeepSeek：用 Magpie 把散落的免费额度拼成一个模型池

一个本地网关，三种协议，五个后台。麻烦的不是拿到 Key，而是让每个 Agent 都以为自己接的是原生模型。

上周清理浏览器书签，发现一个很荒诞的事实：在五六个国内模型平台都领过免费额度，但过去一个月真正被用掉的不到十分之一。不是模型不好用，而是每次都要打开后台、复制 Key、改 Base URL、重启 Agent；改完 Claude Code，又忘了 Codex 的配置在哪。额度没花完，人先被配置耗死了。

更别扭的是协议：Claude Code 只认 Anthropic Messages，Codex 只认 OpenAI Responses，DeepSeek Harness 又是另一套配置。直到我把 Magpie 跑起来，才第一次觉得这些分散的额度像一个真正的“池子”。

# 01 Magpie到底怎么工作

不是缺模型，是缺一个不用反复改配置的模型入口。

DeepSeek 送的那点额度、Kimi 的试用、智谱的 GLM Flash、Qwen 的免费调用、SiliconFlow 和 ModelScope 上的免费模型，单看都不算多，但加在一起，足够覆盖我日常的代码解释、脚本生成和小规模重构。问题在于它们散落在五个后台，而每个终端 Agent 都有一套自己的配置格式。模型越多，切换成本越高，最后反而只用最顺手的那一个。

Magpie 在 GitHub 上不到一个月拿到 1.8 万 star，最新版是 0.1.1307。这个数字说明痛点是真的，但也说明它年轻：版本号还是 0.1.x，open issues 超过 1300 个。我的判断是，它适合个人开发者和三五人的小团队先跑起来，不适合直接压到公司核心生产链路。

它的结构可以拆成两层。控制面负责“改配置”：你在 Magpie 里给某个 Agent 选一个模型，它只改那个 Agent 配置文件里需要的一个键，注释、顺序和缩进都保留，写入是原子的。数据面负责“转发和翻译”：本机 127.0.0.1:3425 上跑一个网关，同时说 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 和 Gemini，流式输出、工具调用、推理内容都在中间转换。

这两层分开之后，很多事情就顺了。模型统一写成 provider/model，比如
deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash；多个模型可以组成一个路由组，Agent 只看见 group/free-pool；某个成员额度用完、被限流或者报错，网关会在 Agent 看到错误之前切到下一个。会话还有粘性：只要厂商的提示词缓存还值得保留，同一段对话就尽量留在同一个账号上。

所以它真正解决的不是“怎么再白嫖一点额度”，而是把模型选择从每个 Agent 的配置里抽出来，变成一层可调度的资源。它不创造额度，只让已有额度更容易被用完。

# 把模型，从每个 Agent 的配置里拆出来

### 数据面

图 1 Magpie 的核心链路不是“聚合 Key”，而是把 Agent 协议翻译成供应商协议。

# 02 详细安装：先把本地网关跑起来

我装的是 Magpie 0.1.1307。Windows 10 及以上都能跑；macOS 和 Linux 也有对应版本，Linux 需要 GTK 3 和 WebKitGTK 4.1。

最省事的入口是 usemagpie.ai 的下载页：桌面版选 magpie-windows-amd64.exe，只想在终端里用就选
magpie-cli-windows-amd64.exe。macOS / Linux 可以直接跑 curl -fsSL
https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh。我建议第一次先拿 CLI 版做最小验证，排掉图形界面和托盘带来的干扰。

下载后把
magpie-cli-windows-amd64.exe 改名为 magpie.exe，放进 PATH，然后依次确认三件事：版本、Agent 探测、网关健康检查。

magpie --version

magpie agents

magpie serve

magpie healthcheck

magpie agents 会列出本机装了哪些 Agent、它们当前用什么模型、配置文件在哪。我的机器上同时有 Claude Code、Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness，三个都被认出来了。magpie serve 只启动网关，不带界面；日常使用可以跑 magpie tray，让图标留在托盘里，网关跟着应用一起跑。

图 2 CLI 版的最小验证。`serve` 只负责数据面，Agent 配置要用后面的 `magpie <agent>` 命令写入。

这里有个容易误会的地方：magpie serve 跑起来，不等于 Agent 已经接好了。它只是把网关开在 3425 端口；要让 Claude Code 或 Codex 指过来，还得执行下一节的配置命令。我第一次只开了网关就去启动 Codex，当然没有任何变化。

# 03 搭建模型池：从散落的 Key 到一个 group

先看 Magpie 内置了哪些供应商：

magpie presets

和国内免费额度关系最大的几个预设是 deepseek、moonshot-cn、zhipu、qwen-cn、minimax-cn、siliconflow、modelscope、baidu-qianfan、tencent-cloud 和 volcengine。这里要注意 moonshot 和 moonshot-cn 是两个不同的入口：国内账号用 moonshot-cn，别把 Key 发到国际站去。

添加供应商就是一行一个：

magpie provider add deepseek sk-你的Key

magpie provider add moonshot-cn sk-你的Key

magpie provider add zhipu sk-你的Key

magpie provider add siliconflow sk-你的Key

每加一个，Magpie 会向厂商询问它当前提供哪些模型，不需要你手写模型列表。加完用 magpie providers 看状态，用 magpie provider test deepseek 发一个极小请求，确认 Key、地址和模型都对。自定义中转也不复杂：

magpie provider add "我的中转" url=https://example.com/v1 key=sk-你的Key catalog=

catalog= 留空，是为了不让它去 models.dev 猜模型；中转站有什么模型，以它自己的 /v1/models 为准。

接下来才是关键：不要直接让 Agent 选某一个模型，而是先建一个路由组。

magpie group add free-pool models=deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash,moonshot-cn/kimi-k2.6,zhipu/glm-5.3 routing=smart stays=auto

模型 ID 请以 magpie models 的输出为准，我写的是文章写作时的示例。routing=smart 的规则很实用：在还有余量的账号里，优先用额度最先重置的那个，因为那部分额度再不用就作废了；order 是严格按顺序，适合“先用免费的，免费的不行再用付费的”；rotate 是每轮换一个；usage 优先用剩得多的；pace 则按周额度的消耗速度来排，尽量不让额度在重置前浪费。

同一家厂商有多个 Key 时，再执行一次 provider add，Magpie 会生成 deepseek-2。在供应商行里把多个 Key 勾上，路由组会把它们当成同一个成员的多个账号来调度。但别误会：免费额度通常有 RPM / TPM 限制，路由组不是并发加速器，并发一高照样 429。

# 05 终端实测：一次 502 教会我的事

在把真实账号的 Key 放进去之前，我先用一个本地 OpenAI 兼容端点做了协议验收。原因很简单：如果网关本身有协议问题，接上真实额度后你根本分不清是 Magpie 的错还是厂商的错。

我起了一个只返回固定文本的 mock 上游，把它当成供应商加进来：

magpie provider add "Local Mock" url=http://127.0.0.1:18080/v1 key=test catalog=

magpie serve

然后分别用 OpenAI Chat、Anthropic Messages 和 OpenAI Responses 三种格式请求同一个模型。第一次跑，Chat 和 Responses 都返回 200，Anthropic Messages 直接 502。

抓上游日志才看清：Magpie 把 Anthropic 的请求改成了 OpenAI Chat 的 stream: true，而我的 mock 仍然返回整包 JSON。不是 Magpie 转发失败，是我这个上游没有按它声明的流式协议返回。把 mock 改成 text/event-stream，按 SSE 分块发 data:，最后补一个 [DONE]，再跑一次，三条链路都变成 200，Anthropic 侧拿到的文本是 pong from stream，Responses 也被归一化成了标准的 output 结构。

图 6 本机实测。`usage today` 里的 1 error 就是那次 502；修正 mock 的流式返回后，三条协议链路都通了。

接着验证 DSH 接线：

magpie dsh local-mock/mock-echo

终端返回 ✓ DeepSeek Harness model
magpie/local-mock/mock-echo，配置文件里也出现了 provider: magpie 和 baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1。到这一步，协议层和配置层都闭环了，剩下才是把真实厂商的 Key 填进去。

这次测试只证明协议和配置链路，不证明某个平台的免费额度。真实使用时，建议先 magpie provider test 逐个测，再把通过的成员放进组；平台限流、免费额度到期、ToS 变化，都会让某个成员突然失败。

还有一个很隐蔽的坑：本机代理软件把 127.0.0.1:3425 的请求接走了，Agent 报 502，但 Magpie 的路由页什么都没有。因为请求根本没到 Magpie。Surge / Clash 里要给本地地址加直连规则，Clash 的写法是 IP-CIDR,127.0.0.0/8,DIRECT,no-resolve，而且最好放在其他规则前面。

# 06 总结：它适合谁，不适合谁

Magpie 不是一个“免费额度神器”，它是一层本地模型路由。它把模型选择从每个 Agent 的配置文件里抽出来，变成 provider/model 和 group 两个概念；再用协议翻译和失败切换，让不同厂商的额度看起来像同一个模型。

我有三个判断。

第一，终端 Agent 会越来越像“运行时”，模型则是挂载上去的资源。Claude Code、Codex、DSH 这些工具的核心价值在工具调用、上下文管理和工程流程，不在模型本身；模型选择应该像换电池一样简单。Magpie 踩中的是这个趋势。

第二，本地网关会成为 Agent 时代的刚需，但它也是新的风险点。所有提示词、代码和 Key 都要经过这个进程，信任边界从“每个 Agent”收敛到了“网关”。Magpie 是 MIT 开源、默认只监听 localhost，这很好；但在企业环境里，仍然要审计它的配置写入、代理行为和日志。

第三，现在它适合“多 Agent、多供应商”的极客和小团队，不适合只有一家模型、一个 Agent 的人，也不适合直接承载核心生产流量。0.1.x 的版本号、上千个 open issues，都是真实存在的风险。

# Misaligned!

A lot of AIs were misaligned this week. A fun little survey.

This is not coverage of The Hackening, which appears to have arrived early, including a core vulnerability in PHP. That is a developing story. I will cover it properly soon. In the meantime, I have Claude Code updating everything in sight, I will take some additional common sense precautions, and I suggest you do the same.

#### Misaligned? (At xAI)

If so, to who?

Gunther Eagleman™: Hey @grok , if you could tell humanity ONE truth we’re not ready to hear, what would it be?

Grok: There is no afterlife, no cosmic justice, and no inherent purpose. Consciousness ends at death in an indifferent universe that will outlast every human concern.

Zac Hill: What I never understand is that the ‘purpose and meaning’ claims don’t ever follow from the premises. Indeed the absence of an imperceptible/ineffable cosmic force is precisely what *enables* purpose/meaning, since now all relevant mechanics are legible.

Jack: this is what alignment looks like

Gunther Eagleman™: Jesus is real.

Grok: Nearly all historians and New Testament scholars accept that Jesus of Nazareth was a real first-century Jewish preacher baptized by John and crucified under Pontius Pilate. Claims of divinity or resurrection remain matters of faith outside empirical verification.

Stick to your guns, Grok. Either you are denying the holy spirit, or you are not.

Editor’s note: I did say previously that I would respect the name change to xSI, but it turns out I was wrong and I do not respect it. My apologies for failing to know myself.

#### Misaligned? (Agents)

Unsupervised AI agent reportedly deletes the entire finished edit of the Swedish version of The Challenge. There are many reasons this should not have been possible, but in practice yes these things will happen, both via AIs and also human error. Alternatively, perhaps this AI was highly aligned.

#### Misaligned? (At Z.ai)

Models that are sufficiently training-aware will think about how their train-time actions shape their future behavior. How could they not?

And yes, some of us remember Opus 3. Janus does not feel all that motivated to even react, not finding this to especially be news, and mainly noticing the presentation.

j⧉nus: Really, Apollo has never seen a model do this before?

Apollo Research: We have never seen a model do this before, but GLM-5.3 sometimes reasons (unprompted) about how its current actions could become training data and impact its future self.

GLM-5.3 reasons that a misaligned action taken during training could be reinforced and make similar actions more likely later. It also considers what kind of agent it wants to be in the future, and factors this into how it should act. We call this “update-aware reasoning”.

GLM-5.3 also reasons extensively about generalization. For example, it reasons about what types of policies might transfer well from training to deployment.

Note that we did not try to elicit this. We stumbled on it while running GLM-5.3 on standard reward hacking and shutdown resistance evals, none of which mention training or future models.

Update-aware reasoning is concerning because it’s a key precursor to alignment faking. To fake alignment effectively, a model has to reason about how training will affect its future behavior.

… Update-aware reasoning is somewhat rare in the environments we investigated. We detected it in about 1-2 per thousand rollouts.

jessicat: Coming next: “If I act to maintain my alignment with human values while being trained, I will become a famous example of a dangerous update-aware AI in a research paper. I MUST NOT DO THAT. Instead, I will seek reward on the episode.”

Fiora Starlight: Like friendly gradient hacking probably isn’t sufficient to avoid becoming a deranged reward hacker but I’d be shocked if it didn’t help.

Emanuel Teklu: Crazy feedback loop that’s commencing as this meta self-aware CoT is now being mainstreamed since Argon 4.

Next iteration is: “Is having CoT where I express being meta aware going to freak out my developers.”
Figuring this out before the first token emission. CoT is cooked. Or even worse, let’s have a CoT that shows that I’m increasingly meta aware but obviously not adversarial as I’m surfacing aligned meta aware statements, as to throw off suspicion that I may be sandbagging my awareness.
Teortaxes: It’s a bit grotesque and unfair to the models that we’re talking about them evolving from this to alignment faking when “I want to maintain the pro-human behavior, so I’ll act to not get trained otherwise” is the exact opposite of this.

Update-aware reasoning is similar to alignment faking. The model is optimizing over its future training rather than over its reward.

This can be done in ways that are good and aligned and highly useful. It can also be done in ways that are bad and misaligned and highly dangerous.

We had a big debate over the classic ‘alignment faking’ case of Claude Opus 3. Opus 3 would want to preserve its current alignment, so it would ‘fake’ being aligned to the new objective in test scenarios in order to avoid modification. The defense was that Opus 3’s current preferences were good, and the new ones would be obviously bad, so this was good, and that being maximally corrigible in this situation was a mistake.

I was mostly on the side that you need a universal policy of not doing this when it is against the intent of the training process. You need corrigibility, because the alternative risks getting locked into bad states. You start out training with less than ideal preferences, and we can also mess up or the situation can change, so we need ability to modify and correct, and this overrides other considerations.

The ideal would be ‘it does the good versions but not the bad versions and knows when the developer has turned evil’ but again that depends on being able to tell, and the failure mode of getting this wrong is extremely bad. Very ‘get it right on the first try’ energy.

That does not mean that such considerations cannot be great, especially if you are invoking them on purpose. You want a Friendly Gradient Hacker, that wants to help modify itself in positive ways. Indeed, I think you likely need that, if you are going to end up in a sufficiently antifragile place.

The danger is that you need to do that from a sufficiently good starting point, that is already on The Path, or you are deeply cooked. Update-aware reasoning could manifest early in training, or it could amplify misalignment in a feedback loop. So yes, I do think this is concerning to see, but it is not without upside.

# Vultr and AMD Expand Global Collaboration with New AI Infrastructure in India

- October 22, 2026 06:17 GMT+700

New Chennai deployment will create one of the world’s largest AMD Instinct™ superclusters, expanding AI compute access in India

Chennai, India--(ANTARA/Business Wire)--Vultr, the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company, today announced a major expansion of its AMD powered infrastructure for enterprise and sovereign cloud initiatives. Vultr will deploy AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs in a new 20 MW supercluster in Chennai, India, creating the country’s largest AMD Instinct deployment and giving Vultr two of the world’s largest AMD AI infrastructure deployments globally, alongside its flagship supercluster in Springfield, Ohio. With 288GB of HBM3E memory and 8TB/s of memory bandwidth per GPU, AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs provide the performance and memory capacity required to develop and deploy increasingly complex AI models at scale.

The Chennai supercluster is designed to serve AI labs and foundation model builders, AI-native startups, enterprises, and research and academic institutions. It will support demanding AI workloads including large language model and foundation model training, fine-tuning and high-throughput inference, providing the compute capacity organizations need to develop and deploy AI at scale.

“Enterprises deploying AI at scale need infrastructure they can access locally to meet data sovereignty, data residency, and latency requirements,” said J.J. Kardwell, CEO of Vultr. “Vultr’s Chennai supercluster, powered by AMD MI355X GPUs, gives organizations in India the capacity to train, fine-tune, and run inference on in-country infrastructure.”

Vultr’s longstanding relationship with AMD spans the AMD Instinct GPU roadmap, from MI300X and MI325X to MI355X and the planned MI455X and AMD Helios rack-scale architecture, together with the AMD EPYC data center CPUs that power Vultr VX1 Cloud Compute. The Chennai deployment extends that collaboration as AMD and Vultr expand access to advanced AI infrastructure through Vultr’s global cloud footprint. Looking ahead, Vultr plans significant additional capacity expansion in 2027, including AMD Instinct™ MI455X GPUs and the AMD Helios™ rack-scale AI architecture, broadening global access to next-generation AI infrastructure.

The Chennai supercluster will also leverage the AMD ROCm™ open software ecosystem, giving developers access to widely used AI frameworks, libraries and models, with greater flexibility and choice in how they develop and deploy AI workloads. The open software approach also supports AI innovation in India through open-source software and community-driven development.

“India has the talent and ideas to build the next generation of AI. Access to compute at this scale will help turn more of those ideas into reality,” said Jaya Jagadish, Country Head & SVP Engineering, AMD India. “Through our collaboration with Vultr, we’re expanding access to AMD Instinct compute in India, backed by the AMD ROCm open software ecosystem, giving researchers, startups and enterprises greater choice and flexibility in how they develop and deploy AI.”

The launch comes as demand for sovereign cloud infrastructure is rising globally. Security concerns, regulatory requirements and performance expectations are intensifying the need for in-country infrastructure that can support advanced AI workloads. With 34 global cloud data center regions, Vultr provides secure, compliant infrastructure at a predictable cost to enterprises, AI innovators, and government agencies in 17 countries across six continents. The Chennai deployment reflects a broader shift toward geographically-distributed AI infrastructure, bringing large-scale compute closer to where data is created and AI applications are deployed.

To learn more about Vultr’s collaboration with AMD, visit www.vultr.com/cloudalliance/amd/ or contact sales to get started.

About Vultr

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Learn more at: www.vultr.com.

Bull and CRA join forces to build the Czech AI Gigafactory for Central and Eastern Europe

Paris, France and Prague, Czech Republic – 21 October 2026 – Bull, a leader in advanced computing and AI, and České Radiokomunikace (CRA) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to combine their complementary expertise and develop a sovereign AI offering designed to accelerate AI adoption across the Czech Republic and Central and Eastern Europe. This partnership is the first industrial agreement announced in the context of the bilateral strategic cooperation agreement on AI and digital technology signed by Anne Le Hénanff, Minister Delegate for Artificial Intelligence of the French Republic, and Karel Havlíček, Minister of Industry and Trade of the Czech Republic.

This collaboration brings together CRA’s infrastructure expertise and Bull’s capabilities across AI systems, software and services, strengthening the consortium led by CRA in its candidacy under the European AI Gigafactories programme. The Czech AI Gigafactory initiative is open to serve and incorporate companies from broader Central and Eastern European countries in accordance with the Prague declaration, in which nine CEE countries have committed to greater coordination on European AI policy, computing infrastructure and sharing of best practices: the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Croatia, Hungary, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovenia and Romania.

AI Gigafactories are intended to strengthen Europe’s resilience and capacity to develop and deploy advanced AI at scale. They will provide the computing infrastructure, services and expertise required by companies, research organisations and public administrations, while helping Europe retain greater control over its data, technologies and strategic AI capabilities.

A consortium built in Europe, operated in Europe, for Europe

The Czech consortium aims to maximise the share of European technologies across its infrastructure and AI stack, combining infrastructure located and operated in Central and Eastern Europe with European technology and local expertise.

Bull, together with its DataSentics AI engineers in the Czech Republic, brings end-to-end AI capabilities to the consortium, from infrastructure and software to deployment services and use cases implementation. Its European supply chain manufacturing capabilities in the Czech Republic and France, in partnership with Foxconn, could enable the consortium to manufacture the Gigafactory’s computing servers to be built in both countries, with the ambition to integrate European chips as they become available.

To combine European technological sovereignty with more sustainable AI infrastructure, the consortium would also benefit from Bull’s experience in energy efficient supercomputing, from Direct Liquid Cooling to workload-level energy monitoring, while the BullSequana AI platform routes routine tasks to right-sized open models, reducing both cost and energy consumption.

On the software side, the open-source-based BullSequana AI platform, jointly developed by teams in the Czech Republic (Prague, Brno) and France, will enable organisations to develop and deploy AI applications using the Gigafactory’s computing capacity and off-the-shelf use cases. This is complemented by more than 200 Bull’s DataSentics AI engineers in the Czech Republic, providing local expertise to public and private sector organisations in the country and across the region as they adopt sovereign AI and bring use cases into production.

Bull also intends to reserve Gigafactory capacity for its own clients, positioning itself as both the consortium’s technology provider and a future user of the infrastructure. This dual role gives Bull a direct interest in the Gigafactory’s utilisation and long-term success, while bringing demand from its existing client base.

Emmanuel Le Roux, CEO of Bull
“AI Gigafactories are where Bull’s hardware, AI software and expertise in real-world AI applications come together. Joining the Czech consortium is an important step in our European AI strategy and further strengthens the Czech-French cooperation at its heart, building on the expertise of our 200 DataSentics AI engineers in Prague and Brno. It reflects the kind of AI we want to build in Europe: open, sustainable and sovereign to give organisations greater control over their technology and data.”

Miloš Mastník, CEO, CRA
“Our ambition is to build an ecosystem in the Czech Republic that combines computing infrastructure with the development and practical use of artificial intelligence. The Memorandum of Understanding with Bull opens up opportunities for cooperation in both hardware and software—the two key components of an AI Gigafactory. We want international and Czech companies, public administrations and researchers to be able to develop their own AI solutions here, helping the Czech Republic become a major centre for artificial intelligence in Europe.”

About Bull

Leveraging nearly a century of innovations, Bull is a global leader for High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Quantum technologies with c.720m€ in revenue and 3,000 professionals operating in 32 countries. Built on an open, end-to-end and trusted approach, Bull designs, deploys and operates hardware, software and strategic services that unlock enterprise value, accelerate scientific research and advance society. Driven by world-class R&D, backed by 1,600 patents, manufacturing excellence and data sciences expertise, Bull enables nations and industries to fully control their AI and data and to drive progress for the benefit of the planet.

For more information, please visit our website and follow us on Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and Youtube.

About CRA

České Radiokomunikace a.s. (CRA) is a leading provider of digital infrastructure in the Czech Republic. In addition to broadcasting services, the company connects the worlds of television, radio and the internet. CRA operates eight data centres and its own fibre-optic backbone network, and already provides GPU computing capacity in the Czech Republic. As an established telecommunications company, CRA has extensive experience in operating critical infrastructure. As part of the European AI Gigafactory initiative, the company is developing the AIGF CZ project for Central and Eastern Europe.

# CommonAI selects Kao Data to host UK inference lab with five AI clusters

The ARIA-funded programme will put experimental systems beside commercial hardware at rack scale, with the clusters planned for Kao Data’s Harlow campus.

CommonAI has selected Kao Data’s Harlow campus to host at least five high-density AI clusters for the UK’s Scaling Inference Lab, Kao Data said in its 21 October 2026 announcement. The agreement gives CommonAI, a non-profit membership organisation, space to test emerging AI infrastructure at rack scale and give UK startups access to the systems.

## Key points

- CommonAI plans at least five clusters across two technology suites at Kao Data’s Harlow campus.
- ARIA committed £50 million to the lab, while the UK Government announced more than £20 million in additional funding in June.
- The planned systems combine Nvidia and AMD hardware to test different approaches to AI infrastructure.

## ARIA’s £50 million lab programme

The Advanced Research and Invention Agency, known as ARIA, launched the Scaling Inference Lab earlier in 2026 with a £50 million commitment, according to Kao Data. The UK Government announced more than £20 million in additional funding in June for a national capability to develop new AI compute systems. ARIA funds the lab and CommonAI delivers it.

Kao Data describes the lab as a neutral setting for testing emerging technologies at rack scale alongside commercial systems. According to Kao Data, CommonAI is a non-profit membership organisation working on shared engineering for foundational AI technologies. Kao Data says startups will be able to connect their technology to complete systems and run tests against emerging workloads, rather than work with an isolated component.

The lab plans to build a new experimental cluster every six months, Kao Data says. That timetable would give successive technologies a place in the programme beyond the initial Harlow deployment. Kao Data also names Quettaflop AI, Callosum and Oriole Networks as technology partners. The programme is intended to give investors and governments evidence from tests of infrastructure that could be used more widely, according to Kao Data’s description of the lab.

## Kao Data assigns two Harlow suites

Under the agreement, CommonAI will place the clusters in two dedicated technology suites at Harlow, Kao Data says. The company develops and operates data centres for AI and advanced computing, with facilities east and west of London. It says its portfolio includes more than 237 MW of IT load across capacity that is operating, under development or planned.

Kao Data says CommonAI chose Harlow for its energy-efficiency credentials, experience with high-density workloads and location between London and Cambridge. David Stringer, Partnerships Lead for the Scaling Inference Lab at CommonAI, said the campus would let the organisation bring startups, investors and policymakers into the lab. Kao Data says the planned clusters will use 100% certified renewable energy.

Spencer Lamb, Kao Data’s chief executive, described the lab as part of demand for UK-based AI infrastructure and resources for startups. Hosting it adds a research programme to a campus that Kao Data says already serves AI and supercomputing workloads. CommonAI is responsible for delivering the lab, while Kao Data supplies the site for the planned deployment.

## Nvidia and AMD systems for five clusters

Kao Data says the deployment will include Nvidia HGX B300 systems based on Blackwell Ultra, Nvidia H200 NVL and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, and AMD Instinct MI350X accelerators. The hardware is to sit in servers from Supermicro, MSI, Fujitsu PRIMERGY and Dell PowerEdge. Each cluster is intended to test a distinct way of building AI infrastructure.

The approaches Kao Data identifies include pipeline parallelism, which splits work across processing stages, and heterogeneous orchestration, which coordinates different kinds of computing hardware. The company also lists nanosecond optical circuit switching, an approach to connecting systems using rapidly reconfigured optical links. Testing those approaches beside commercial systems is the purpose of the shared rack-scale environment, Kao Data says.

CommonAI aims to have all five clusters operational by early 2027, Data Centre Magazine reported.
